title: pb_int64_to_float
description: `pb_int64_to_float` converts a decimal-integer symbol, such as a 64-bit field emitted by `pb_decode`, to a Pd `t_float`; float input passes through unchanged. It reports a Pd error and emits nothing for non-decimal symbols or values whose magnitude exceeds 2^24, the exact-integer range stated by the patch.
